title: Simulate your future
inspection: six evenly spaced frames visually reviewed
viewport: mobile portrait; encoded pixel dimensions are not device-point dimensions
observations: A pale savings dashboard and checklist open into a dark projection view with a large gradient number and vertical bars. A rounded money-entry sheet introduces a numeric keypad and recurring/one-off options; later frames show an updated projection and a return to the dashboard.
learning_candidate: An interactive example can demonstrate the product before setup is complete; financial figures here are recorded UI content, not validated outcomes.
